verdict.rationale: Pipecat ships a local development runner and is a pip-installable, self-hostable framework, so bots can be run and exercised locally, apart from a Pipecat Cloud or production deployment. Local LLM and STT inference (ollama, whisper) can also keep testing off hosted providers. However, there is no documented sandbox or test-mode environment that isolates production data, and Evals explicitly run against 'the same pipeline, the same services' rather than mocked or sandboxed ones. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox/staging environment, documented isolation from production data, mock or test-mode services for evals, and independent hands-on corroboration.
